production.method: each demo code opened as https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter?d=<code>: HTTP 200 with that dataset's own page title means production carries it; 404 means it does not yet. industrialEstate, cameraShops, luxuryBrands, pharmacy and transit answered 404; Commercial District, Fitness and University write no code, and commercialDistrict, fitness and university answered 404 too. tourism answered 200 with the page title of the tourism dataset (“ความต้องการท่องเที่ยว: จำนวนนักท่องเที่ยวและค่าใช้จ่าย”); every other code answered as on 2026-11-25.

sources.list: citymeter-shell 0.6.6 js/shell/datasets.js, the dataset picker in every demo header: path, name and group; every demo on 0.6.6 since 2026-11-27 (0.6.6 adds Tourism to 0.6.5's list; 0.6.5 changed only js/shell/header.js — the language link no longer writes its words again as it is pressed, so EN can be clicked in Safari — and kept 0.6.4's list, which marks Shopping Center as a demo with English on 0.6.3's list, which added Housing Estate)
sources.groups: dataset registry R01_DATASETS (dataset_group, demo_web_url), read 2026-11-18: the seventeen demos read the same groups as on 2026-11-16 (Hospital and School are Living since the owner's decision of 2026-11-12, registry change CHANGE-LIVING-HEALTH-EDUCATION-20261112-01; Location in the reading of 2026-11-08; University, research.TH.university, is Living and has a demo since 2026-11-12); Commercial District has its row since (research.TH.commercialdistrict, Location, as the owner asked on 2026-11-16); Housing Estate (research.TH.housing_estate) is Land and has a demo since 2026-11-18; read again 2026-11-25: all eighteen demos have the same groups; read again 2026-11-27: the eighteen demos have the same groups, and Tourism (research.TH.tourism_supply) is Location (group basis owner_confirmed_tourism_supply_location_2026-11-27) and has a demo since 2026-11-27
sources.codes: each demo's address code d, the production ?d= code (owner 2026-11-08); a demo whose dataset production does not carry yet writes its own code (Industrial Estate, Camera Shops, Luxury Brands, Pharmacy, Transit) or none (Commercial District, Fitness, University); `production` holds the code only where production carries it, checked 2026-11-25 (`production` above); Housing Estate writes estate, the production estate layer; Tourism writes tourism, the production tourism layer (product_dataset_id is still empty in the registry read 2026-11-27)
sources.questions: each demo page's meta description, quoted, read 2026-11-09; questionDraft.en is an unreviewed draft; University's read 2026-11-12; Commercial District's read 2026-11-16; Housing Estate's read 2026-11-18; Tourism's read 2026-11-27
sources.areas: area names as the demos show them in their breadcrumb for these codes, checked 2026-11-09
sources.languages: a demo declares English with <meta name="citymeter:languages" content="th en"> (citymeter-shell 0.5.0): Office since its release 0.4.0; Hotel since 0.6.0 and Hospital since 0.4.0 (citymeter-shell 0.5.1); School since 0.5.0, Government Office since 0.7.0 and Factory since 0.5.0 (citymeter-shell 0.5.2); Pharmacy since 0.3.0 and Restaurants since 0.11.0 (citymeter-shell 0.5.3); Industrial Estate since its release 1.0.0 (citymeter-shell 0.5.4); University since its release 0.1.0 (citymeter-shell 0.6.1); Commercial District since its release 0.1.0 (citymeter-shell 0.6.2); Housing Estate since its release 0.1.0 (citymeter-shell 0.6.3); Shopping Center since its release 0.7.0 (citymeter-shell 0.6.4); Tourism since its release 0.1.0 (citymeter-shell 0.6.6)
sources.pages: a demo kept inside another demo's repository has its own path on GitHub Pages (`pages`): Industrial Estate lives in the factory repository at factory/industrialestate/ (citymeter-shell 0.5.4)
sources.groupsEstate: Industrial Estate: registry research.TH.industrial_estates, group Land, read 2026-11-10, 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-16
sources.registryIds: registryId is registry_dataset_id in R01_DATASETS, read 2026-11-25 for all eighteen demos (until 2026-11-25 the cards showed only the address code and said “ยังไม่มีในทะเบียน” for the three demos without one, although all three have a registry row); read again 2026-11-27 for all nineteen demos (Tourism: research.TH.tourism_supply)
sources.summaries: each card's summary is the demo page's meta description after its question; Commercial District's (release 0.4.0, 395 neighbourhoods) and Industrial Estate's re-read 2026-11-25 from the live pages, where they had changed since the hub quoted them; Tourism's read 2026-11-27
